name: Palabra.ai
description: Speech translation API with one-minute transient caches.
overview: Palabra.ai offers speech-to-speech translation and text-to-speech with $50 of trial credit. Ordinary API audio and text are not persistently stored or trained on and transient caches last at most a minute; recording and voice cloning are explicit exceptions.
free_access: Caches last at most one minute
notes: Recording and voice cloning retain data explicitly.
